description: Negative: EHR-extracted social history record with a category outside the defined value set
shaclConstraintViolated: clinical:SocialHistoryRecordShape constrains clinical:socialHistoryCategory with sh:in (smokingStatus alcoholUse substanceUse occupation exercise diet sexualHistory other). 'tobacco' is not one of them.
notes: Covers the clinical: spelling of the dual-namespaced pair. The health: spelling (social-001, social-002) cannot have a negative counterpart today: health:SocialHistoryRecordShape declares only sh:Info-severity constraints, so no input can make it report a violation.
